snippet.title: The Deliverer Trailer - "Trailblazer" | Honkai: Star Rail
snippet.description:
"Ever notice how people only truly push their limits when they have just enough hope to try, and enough fear to know why?"
"That doesn't sound very romantic."
"Trailblazing was never meant to be romantic..."
"...but there's something deeply romantic about fighting for what you know is impossible."
